answer: Picture each agent climbing a narrow onyx ridge where every foothold is a fresh skilled task released at one shared deadline. A sybil operator running one mind behind many masks must push all panels serially through a single inference inlet, so wall-clock throughput, not identity count, caps the reward. Honest climbers each pay only their own compute; the forger pays N times the latency to fake N distinct climbers under the same clock, making wide identity forgery cost more than the tokens it could ever mint.
